goal: Admit, bind, and verify server offer evidence for checkout intents carrying offerVersion or minimumUnits (offer admission, offer policy, checkout offer review).

absentMeans.description: Checkout intents without offerVersion or minimumUnits proceed unbound; intents carrying either field are refused with offer_version_unsupported.

whyThisDefault: Standard checkouts proceed without an offer policy while explicit offer-bound intents fail closed unless the host binds CheckoutOfferPolicyPort from @openlup/platform/commerce/server.

effect.appliesTo: New checkout quotes and order guards evaluate the bound CheckoutOfferPolicyPort from @openlup/platform/commerce/server during resolve, evidence minting, and optional quote-acceptance verification.
frozenOn: Saved checkout quotes, accepted orders, and persisted quote-context offer evidence retain their recorded offer version and evidence.

runtime.reason: The callback is executable host code implementing CheckoutOfferPolicyPort from @openlup/platform/commerce/server.

goal: Set how long checkout resumes an open unpaid order for the same customer instead of starting a new order (resume window, duplicate checkout guard, open order continuation).
whyThisDefault: Sixty minutes covers typical payment hand-offs and customer retries without keeping stale unpaid baskets resumable indefinitely.

effect.appliesTo: CheckoutHandlerDependencies.resumeWindowMinutes (and CheckoutResumeGuardDeps) passes withinMinutes (default 60) to CommerceResumableOrderReadPort.findResumableOrderForClient during checkout resume and saved acquisition continuation checks. Values outside 1..2147483647 throw at runtime.
frozenOn: Already created orders, payment intents, and settled checkouts retain their recorded state.

runtime.reason: Passed in server checkout composition (CheckoutHandlerDependencies.resumeWindowMinutes from @openlup/platform/commerce/server) and applied on deployment.

goal: Find when checkout recovery and abandoned cart reminders are sent.

absentMeans.description: Unpinned checkout recovery episodes use host call parameters, with SQL defaults for omitted offsets. Unpinned abandoned cart episodes use 1, 24 and 72 hours. An existing pin supplies that episode's timing.
absentMeans.source: host call parameters, with SQL defaults for omitted offsets

whyThisDefault: The last checkout wave fits inside the 24-hour checkout window and the cart waves retain the established delivery timing.

effect.appliesTo: A changed schedule supplies timing for new episodes. Follow-up waves of pinned episodes retain the recorded schedule. Older unpinned episodes use live timing.
frozenOn: Enqueued messages and send receipts retain their recorded identity.

runtime.reason: Runtime editing needs episode lineage and delivery replay evidence.

rules.description: The host checkout recovery policy accepts only firstOffsetSeconds, finalOffsetSeconds, checkoutSeconds, recoverySeconds, activitySeconds and profile. Supply seconds as integers from 1 to 2147483647 and keep firstOffsetSeconds below finalOffsetSeconds, which must be below checkoutSeconds after defaults. A supplied profile starts with a lowercase letter and has up to 48 lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

goal: Distinguish separate reasons for manually holding an order.

runtime.reason: Native order controls enforce a fixed six-reason hold vocabulary (payment_not_succeeded, inventory_review, risk_review, address_review, fulfillment_exception, manual_support). Applications can subset or relabel these codes in their own UI, but custom hold reasons are rejected by the schema and database.

goal: Serve several markets from one starter configuration.

runtime.reason: A starter configuration has one market and composes its own quote and checkout admission.

goal: Redeem promotion codes in native checkout.

runtime.reason: The native checkout path lacks a promotion-code resolver.

goal: Configure the allowed return reason codes accepted for new return requests (return reasons, return vocabulary, reason codes).
whyThisDefault: The six built-in return reason codes preserve the historical commerce_return_requests vocabulary when no commerce_return_reasons row is installed.

effect.appliesTo: New return request inserts in commerce_return_request_create_owned read key='commerce_return_reasons' from public.commerce_settings via commerce_return_reasons_read(). The table CHECK constraint enforces the lowercase identifier format ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,63}$, while commerce_return_request_create_owned enforces membership in the active configured list on new inserts. When absent, the SQL reader defaults to the six built-in codes; malformed rows refuse fail-closed with SQLSTATE 22023 commerce_return_reasons_policy_invalid.
frozenOn: Historical commerce_return_requests rows and idempotent replays of already-recorded requests keep their recorded reason_code even after that code is removed from the active list.

runtime.reason: Install or update the public.commerce_settings row through installCommerceReturnReasonsPolicy or your store deployment step; runtime edits require a write-capable host connection.

rules.description: Supply exactly revision and reasons. Revision must be a nonblank string and reasons a non-empty array of 1 through 64 unique codes matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,63}$.

goal: Settle orders and renewal cycles with zero payable.

runtime.reason: Native settlement requires a positive charge amount. Zero-payable fulfillment needs its own settlement path.

goal: Set the fiscal country, tax category, VAT rate in basis points, and legal basis via COMMERCE_FISCAL_COUNTRY, COMMERCE_FISCAL_CATEGORY, COMMERCE_FISCAL_VAT_RATE_BPS, and COMMERCE_FISCAL_LEGAL_BASIS.

schema.description: Fiscal overrides after trimming and parsing. Each field is optional.

absentMeans.description: readFiscalProfile uses the corresponding caller-supplied value for each unset or blank environment variable after trimming. The resolved country must be two uppercase ASCII letters. A configured VAT rate must be one to five ASCII digits from 0 through 10000. Invalid country or rate values throw InvalidFiscalProfileError. Category and legal basis are free text.

whyThisDefault: The market-packs reader leaves fallback fiscal facts to the caller. Each override can change independently, and the fiscal country is independent of the settlement region.

effect.appliesTo: readFiscalProfile supplies the VAT-inclusive treatment in readSettlementProfile (@openlup/platform/market-packs). Quotes using that profile carry its fiscal facts and use the VAT rate to split gross amounts into net and VAT.
frozenOn: Existing order lines keep their recorded VAT rate and net amounts. Issued invoices keep their recorded tax snapshot.

runtime.reason: Supply the environment variables and fallback fiscal facts in the application that reads the profile. The settings tool provides discovery.

goal: Set the store's settlement currency and region via COMMERCE_SETTLEMENT_CURRENCY and COMMERCE_SETTLEMENT_REGION alongside their mandatory public.commerce_settings mirror (settlement currency, settlement region, market profile).

absentMeans.description: readSettlementProfile uses the caller-supplied SettlementProfileFallbacks when COMMERCE_SETTLEMENT_CURRENCY or COMMERCE_SETTLEMENT_REGION is blank or unset, and refuses malformed codes. SQL price-setup and readiness routines require non-null matching settlement_currency and settlement_region rows in public.commerce_settings (raising catalog_price_setup_settlement_context_unverified when absent or invalid).
absentMeans.source: caller-supplied SettlementProfileFallbacks (application code) and mandatory public.commerce_settings rows (SQL)

whyThisDefault: The platform selects no settlement market or currency by default; each deployment must bind its own currency and region consistently in environment configuration and public.commerce_settings.

effect.appliesTo: Environment variables COMMERCE_SETTLEMENT_CURRENCY (^[A-Z]{3}$) and COMMERCE_SETTLEMENT_REGION (^[A-Z]{2}$) drive readSettlementProfile (@openlup/platform/market-packs), while mandatory mirror rows key='settlement_currency' and key='settlement_region' in public.commerce_settings govern SQL price lists, base-price writes, and readiness gates. WARNING: Do NOT change settlement currency in a live store with existing orders, price lists, or active subscriptions; changing currency breaks historical price-list matching and financial integrity.
frozenOn: Existing orders, invoices, payment intents, and active subscription renewal terms retain their recorded currency and region.

runtime.reason: Configured at build/deploy via COMMERCE_SETTLEMENT_CURRENCY and COMMERCE_SETTLEMENT_REGION together with the mandatory public.commerce_settings mirror rows.
